new_senses.rationale: Freedom is given as a condition for judging the person; neither monetary lending nor physical support fits. One attestation. I is provisional from the unprefixed ability complement.

added_examples.translation: Look! God creates a person free! If he is not free, he cannot judge him!
added_examples.rationale: Only Infectum 1 attestation; free-will premise and ability complement make judging clear. Preterit base is explicitly unattested.
